name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: Microsoft's AI assistant integrated into Microsoft 365 apps such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams.
description: Microsoft 365 Copilot is the Copilot product at microsoft.com/copilot. The page title is Microsoft Copilot, built for work in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams, with chat, agents and research. The same page also lists Copilot for individuals. The Microsoft business page lists bundles that include Copilot at several price points per user per month, paid yearly, with a free trial; because the bundles differ, no single starting price was recorded.
